description: State Ministry of Home Affairs - The Regulation of Walathara Paramaramaniyarama Purana Maha Vihara Perahera. Deruwala
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the State Minister under the Pilgrimages Ordinance, establishing a legal and regulatory framework for managing a specific religious festival. It creates binding rules, defines terms, grants powers to officials, and outlines compliance requirements and penalties, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification for subsidiary legislation and regulatory matters.
